title: Malzahar - The Void Beckons
author: Katrian
general: Short guide with no matchups. Early game is weak: farm and shove with E plus W, keep wave priority, chip turret plates when safe and rely on the passive spell shield to absorb early ganks or trades (keep it up for those moments). Combo E then Q then W for safe poke and full damage, and put E on cannon minions to spread it through the wave. He is a mid-game champion whose spike comes roughly between 25 and 35 minutes, falling off afterward, so snowball around the 20-minute mark: push and rotate to objectives, ward Dragon and Baron, and use R (ideally right after a Q silence) to catch overextended carries with your jungler. Late, stay behind the frontline, never engage first, and suppress the key assassin or ADC.
